description: Remediate the incomplete APK asset ABI, then generate and integrate the required Chibi Quest and Riven Lands sprite packs across every current cartridge and edition.
deviation_notes: Corrects a material APK foundation closeout error. The archived foundation implemented loader dispatch and placeholder slot validation, but not the specified physical sprite-sheet, animation, view-variant, anchor, collision, shared-source, or semantic frame-binding contract. W0-W4 prove mechanics over procedural placeholders only. This track must repair that ABI before producing and integrating both packs.

sprint.goal: APK exposes a real sprite asset ABI and every current cartridge renders production Chibi Quest and Riven Lands sheets through validated semantic frame and animation bindings with no procedural placeholders.
